intuition: A dummy head makes insertion and deletion at index zero follow the same predecessor logic as other positions.

brute_force.approach: Store values in a dynamic array and shift elements after indexed insertions and deletions.
brute_force.time: get O(1), addAtHead O(n), addAtTail O(1), addAtIndex O(n), deleteAtIndex O(n)

optimal.approach: Use a singly linked list and walk to the predecessor for indexed operations.
optimal.time: get O(n), addAtHead O(1), addAtTail O(n), addAtIndex O(n), deleteAtIndex O(n)

edge_cases: An insertion at the current length appends, while larger indices are ignored.
